svg.title: OPAL offline sync sequence diagram
svg.desc: Sequence between operator, on-device queue, replayer, OPAL API and database: plan freshness check, actions queued offline with deterministic request keys, a single replayer holding a lease, idempotent writes on the server, retries with backoff for temporary failures, and blocked items shown to the operator.
svg.text: Offline sync: every action is saved on the device first, then replayed once
How OPAL keeps operator data consistent between a tablet with no connection and the server.
cached on the device while online
Is the cached plan fresh enough?
warn the operator before going offline if not
Safety check · scan record · plan edit · run complete
each action written with a deterministic request key
page and service worker hand off; only one holds it
Mark blocked — shown to the operator
All synced — status back to online
Amber: queued on the device · Teal: synced with the server · Red: failure handling · Dashed: reply
